newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grain export commitments down on last year.
newsitem.headline: EU grain export commitments down on last year.

text.p: Latest European Union figures show grain export commitments between July 1 and November 12 were 6.12 percent below year-ago levels, mostly reflecting a fall in wheat sales, member-country officials said on Friday.
The figures, based on delivered export certificates, showed grain exports at 10.144 million tonnes against 10.805 million.
Commercial wheat exports fell to 3.049 million tonnes from 3.691 million last year.
Flour export commitments reached 2.063 million tonnes down from 2.697 million in the same period last year.
Commercial barley exports, however, jumped to 2.133 million tonnes from 940,000 tonnes during the same period last year, helped by sales to Saudi Arabia.
Malt exports fell to 1.749 million tonnes from 1.908 million.
Commercial oats commitments reached 183,000 tonnes. The EU made no oats sales during the same period last year.
Since November 12 the EU has granted 256,500 tonnes of soft wheat, 279,125 tonnes of barley and 7,000 tonnes of rye exports through its weekly grain tender system.
